name: Marvel Biosciences Corp.
summary: Marvel Biosciences Corp. is a biotechnology company in Canada developing synthetic chemical derivatives of an already approved drug for new disease indications. Its lead compound, MB-204, is a derivative of istradefylline, an adenosine A2a receptor antagonist, with added fluorine, aimed at Alzheimer's disease, autism spectrum disorder, depression and anxiety. The company is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
